feature_contract.goal: Preserve the original player contact shadow at race startup and gameplay as a source-owned binocular world draw, rejecting foreign raw car/road c64 before native LEFT or reentrant left-to-right ownership changes while preserving the normal shadow and existing native fallback.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only the exact original direct CarBaseShadow world producer and independent R84 R30/R33 native c64 stereo transaction. No SkyGlow, lens, +TIME, GOAL, rank, input, FFB, shader world, frozen DXVK or R26_SAFE changes.
trace_stages: Original player car contact-shadow direct producer records WorldParticle/CarBaseShadow semantic and its original game c64 writer.
R84 R30 authorizes same-pose same-shader original c64 for immediate stereo eye constants and R33 revalidates before native LEFT submission.
R84 R33 revalidates the original game upload and physical shadow after native LEFT, refusing an unrelated RIGHT before eye composition while restoring the original game WVP and state.
subcomponents: Revalidate raw original car-shadow shader, upload pose, immediate draw serial, source semantic and nonqueue identity in R33 before LEFT, rather than relying only on earlier R30 classification.
Fence both GPU eyes by an executable original-write/draw-generation coherence contract with rollback and mutation regressions for unrelated world and reentrant game c64 sources.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Original player contact-shadow direct c64 producer through R84 left and right GPU submissions
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Source-coherent original game c64 is required at native LEFT and survives native RIGHT with identical physical stamp, not stale road or other car matrices.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Foreign original game WVP, mixed queue, pose and shader changes, native mono fallback plus protected world/sky
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Foreign or missing source falls back before native LEFT with original WVP rollback; after-left drift blocks RIGHT without replaying the first eye or changing unrelated source.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: DX9Ex Active R84 and R26_SAFE native Windows x86, x64 OpenXR host, package, Domain, Inspector and Full Source gates
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: One exact committed source SHA passes required GitHub Actions and matching Quest3 visual evidence remains separate.

diagnosis.original_evidence: R30 already authorizes exact direct shadow original c64 with next-draw proof, but R33 captured a weaker source after temporary left-eye upload and skipped the shadow in its pre-left reject branch.
source_trace: src/vr/game/render_semantics.hpp exact original contact-shadow producer command
src/vr/d3d9/stereo_renderer_r33.cpp GPU LEFT and RIGHT c64 revalidation plus rollback
diagnosis.root_cause: Between R30 classification and actual native LEFT GPU submission, nested original game work may overwrite c64 or queue identity. R33 checked raw source changes only after LEFT, allowing a foreign left-eye shadow draw; it also did not compare original writer generation against the immediate draw.
alternatives_rejected: Do not classify arbitrary alpha/world particles as player shadow, apply HUD flattening, hide any original shadow or suppress the first native GPU draw.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Added exact original direct-WVP generation recheck and source-owned native pre-left/after-left guards with C++ smoke, without touching original game binary assets.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Portable C++ shadow smoke verifies original current-draw source and mutations for prior/future draw, missing write serial, invalid pose/shader and reentrant writer after LEFT.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Left and right use the same original game c64 producer/write, top-level draw generation, shader/pose and physical shadow, or preserve original native fallback when source proof is lost.
diagnosis.evidence_limit: No matching Quest3 / VDXR runtime observed; deterministic native pre-left source mismatch prevention is not a hardware proof that the race-start shadow is visually fixed.
